cards.title: It’s Your Armor
cards.body: Influencers, advertisers, and algorithms try to change what you think. Ask: “Who wants me to believe this? What’s the evidence? What’s missing?”

cards.title: It Kills Boredom
cards.body: A good question makes ordinary things interesting. How does that work? Why do people do it that way? What could be different?

cards.title: It Helps You Grow
cards.body: You’ll receive feedback throughout your life. Be curious when you hear it. What worked? What could improve? Ask for an example, then use what you learn.

cards.title: Learn as You Live
cards.body: It’s okay if you don’t have your life figured out today. Stay curious. Try new things, meet people, and notice what interests you. Let what you discover help you choose your next step.

cards.title: Use AI Regularly
cards.body: Use it beyond school. Regular use helps you notice when the tool changes or gains new abilities.

cards.title: Check What Changed
cards.body: Look for update notices, new buttons, model names, or a What’s New page. Check occasionally, not constantly.

cards.title: Follow One Reliable Source
cards.body: Choose one trustworthy newsletter, video channel, educator, or official product page. One good source is enough.

cards.title: Compare with Others
cards.body: Ask friends, teachers, or AI club members what they tried recently. Different people notice different things.
